claims: Troves nobody has looked at for 5+ minutes get a "snapshot unavailable" preview, even when Hasura is working fine — `ui-dashboard/src/app/cdps/[symbol]/troves/[troveId]/_lib/trove-og-data.ts:273-274`: unstable_cache returns the stale value while revalidating, and the freshness check then returns `null`
Tests don't catch it: `trove-og-data.test.ts:12-25` replaces `unstable_cache` with a plain passthrough, and the freshness test (lines 227-239) only checks the age calculation on its own
`trove-og-data.ts:121-131`, `compactNumber` rounds up but never moves to the next unit. 999,999 USDm shows as `1000K USDm` instead of `1M`, and 999.999 shows as `1,000.00`
Two copies of the ICR colour rule: `icrTone` (`trove-og-data.ts:152`) is a copy of `icrTextClass` (`_lib/format.ts:44`), with no note saying to keep them in step
The same `decodeURIComponent` wrapper exists in three places: `page.tsx:8`, `opengraph-image.tsx:21` and `trove-og-data.ts:51`
Outdated comment: `trove-og-data.ts:184` has an "@internal Exported for … tests" comment on a function that isn't exported

judge_reasoning.3882086206: The review's follow-ups flag icrTone (trove-og-data.ts:152) as a copy of icrTextClass (_lib/format.ts:44) that could drift apart. That is the same duplication defect.
judge_reasoning.3882119274: The review never says that event-time icrBps is stale after oracle price changes, or that it is shown as a live health signal without an 'indexed' label.
judge_reasoning.3882119284: The review's cache finding is the opposite problem: stale unstable_cache entries causing 'unavailable' (null) previews. It does not flag the combined data age plus image Cache-Control/SWR letting data reach about 11 minutes old.

1.why: trove-og-data.ts:254-274: unstable_cache (revalidate 60) serves the stale entry while it refreshes in the background, so after 5+ idle minutes fetchedAtMs fails troveOgDataIsFresh (5-min cap) and null is returned even though Hasura is healthy

2.why: trove-og-data.test.ts:12-25 mock returns fn unchanged; the freshness test at ~227-239 only calls troveOgDataIsFresh with hand-built data, so the stale-serve path from claim 1 is never tested

3.why: Ran compactNumber logic: 999999 -> '1000K', 999.999 -> '1,000.00', 999999999 -> '1000000K'; thresholds are checked before rounding

4.why: icrTone (trove-og-data.ts:152) matches icrTextClass (format.ts:44) threshold for threshold; this is the known icrTone duplication defect

5.why: page.tsx:48-50 adds a shortTroveId identical to the exported one at _og/trove-og-card.tsx:115, which opengraph-image.tsx already imports

6.why: The same try/decodeURIComponent/catch wrapper is at page.tsx:8 (already there before this change), opengraph-image.tsx:21 and trove-og-data.ts:51; this diff adds two of the three copies

7.why: trove-og-data.ts:184 '@internal Exported for focused data-contract tests' sits on `async function fetchTroveOgData`, which is not exported; the comment was copied from line 217
